Rhea (release): Quick sync: small spike of timeouts in eu-central after runtime 3.5.0 + SDK 2.10. Customers hitting long-history chat flows. Suggest regional soft-pin/unpin plan.
Owen (runtime): We see increased tail latencies tied to a new kernel selection path for quantized attention. Not solid crashes but timeouts at p99.
Mina (sdk): If we do a regional mitigation I can push a routing override that pins affected projects to runtime 3.4.2 in eu-central for a short window. Will add console label + audit.
Leo (qa): I can run a quick post-pin smoke with mix of seq lengths (2k/10k/25k) and watch p99.
Rhea (release): Plan: 1) apply 2h soft-pin runtime=3.4.2 for model_family=llama3-q in eu-central; 2) SDK routing override + console label; 3) runtime triage kernel heuristics; 4) QA canary and smoke; 5) CS note if we extend.
Mina (sdk): I'll prepare the override. deploybot, schedule in 4m with 5m cooldown.
deploybot: Received request:
  action: soft-pin
  runtime: 3.4.2
  model_filter: family=llama3-q
  scope: region=eu-central
  window: 2h
  cooldown: 5m
  initiated_by: Rhea (release)
deploybot: Running preflight checks...
ci-bot: Preflight: routing OK; capacity headroom 19% in eu-central; no blocking hotfixes.
Mina (sdk): Override pushed. Console label: "eu-central-pin-6543210000". Audit id: aud-6543.
Leo (qa): Post-pin smoke: 30m run, no timeouts, p99 down ~35%.
Owen (runtime): Canary eval 50 reqs: median +2ms, p95 +8ms, p99 improved. Adding instrumentation to kernel selector for 3.5.1 fix.
Rhea (release): Great. Keeping triage open. If runtime patch is ready we'll schedule a targeted 3.5.1 rollout and remove pin. Closing this thread when pin lifted. :white_check_mark:
